```{r}
#| label: allen-oh-2020

# Importing data
allen_oh_2020_raw <- read_excel("Ohio 2020/Data/Allen County CVR Data/Allen_OH_2020.xlsx") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  suppressWarnings()

# Restructuring the data
allen_oh_2020 <- allen_oh_2020_raw |> 
  
  # Selecting races of interest (major partisan races and Supreme Court)
  select(cast_vote_record, for_president_and_vice_president, 
         for_representative_to_congress_4th_district, 
         for_state_senator_12th_district, for_state_representative_4th_district, 
         for_justice_of_the_supreme_court_1_1,
         for_justice_of_the_supreme_court_1_2
         ) |> 
  # Renaming columns/races for conciseness
  rename(
    pres = for_president_and_vice_president,
    us_rep_4d = for_representative_to_congress_4th_district,
    state_sen_12d = for_state_senator_12th_district,
    state_rep_4d = for_state_representative_4th_district,
    sc_justice_20_1 = for_justice_of_the_supreme_court_1_1,
    sc_justice_20_2 = for_justice_of_the_supreme_court_1_2
  ) |> 
  
  # Filtering out any ballots that had an error or chose not to vote in any races of interest
  filter(
    if_all(everything(), ~ is.na(.) | !grepl("undervote|overvote", 
                                                  as.character(.),
                                                  ignore.case = TRUE)),
         !is.na(pres),
         str_detect(pres, "Rep|Dem"),
         str_detect(us_rep_4d, "Rep|Dem"),
         str_detect(state_sen_12d, "Rep|Dem"),
         !(is.na(state_rep_4d))
    ) |> 
  
  # Changing ballot choices from candidates' names to their respective parties
  mutate(
    pres = if_else(
      str_detect(pres, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    us_rep_4d = if_else(
      str_detect(us_rep_4d, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    state_sen_12d = if_else(
      str_detect(state_sen_12d, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    state_rep_4d = if_else(
      str_detect(state_rep_4d, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    sc_justice_20_1 = if_else(
      str_detect(sc_justice_20_1, "Sharon"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    sc_justice_20_2 = if_else(
      str_detect(sc_justice_20_2, "Judi"), "GOP", "DEM"),
  ) |> 
  
  # Creating variable to label whether or not a voter voted exclusively for one party in the races of interest, besides the Supreme Court races
  mutate(
    party_line_voter = case_when(
      pres == "GOP" & us_rep_4d == "GOP" & state_sen_12d == "GOP" &
      state_rep_4d == "GOP" ~ "GOP",
      pres == "DEM" & us_rep_4d == "DEM" & state_sen_12d == "DEM" &
      state_rep_4d == "DEM" ~ "DEM",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  ) |> 
  
  # Creating variable to label whether or not a voter's Supreme Court race choices aligned with their choices for the other races of interest
  mutate(
    sc_races_matching = case_when(
      party_line_voter == "GOP" & sc_justice_20_1 == "GOP" &
      sc_justice_20_2 == "GOP" ~ TRUE,
      party_line_voter == "DEM" & sc_justice_20_1 == "DEM" &
      sc_justice_20_2 == "DEM" ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: ashtabula-oh-2020

# Importing data
ashtabula_oh_2020_raw <- read_excel("Ohio 2020/Data/Ashtabula County CVR Data/Ashtabula_OH_2020.xlsx") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  suppressWarnings()

# Restructuring the data
ashtabula_oh_2020 <- ashtabula_oh_2020_raw |> 
  
  # Selecting races of interest (major partisan races and Supreme Court)
  select(cast_vote_record, president_and_vice_president, representative_to_congress_14th_district, 
         state_senator_32nd_district, state_representative_64th_district,          
         state_representative_99th_district, justice_of_the_supreme_court_18,
         justice_of_the_supreme_court_19) |> 
  # Renaming columns/races for conciseness
  rename(
    pres = president_and_vice_president,
    us_rep_14d = representative_to_congress_14th_district,
    state_sen_32d = state_senator_32nd_district,
    state_rep_64d = state_representative_64th_district,
    state_rep_99d = state_representative_99th_district,
    sc_justice_20_1 = justice_of_the_supreme_court_18,
    sc_justice_20_2 = justice_of_the_supreme_court_19
  ) |> 
  
  # Filtering out any ballots that had an error or chose not to vote in any races of interest
  filter(
    if_all(everything(), ~ is.na(.) | !grepl("undervote|overvote", 
                                                  as.character(.),
                                                  ignore.case = TRUE)),
         !is.na(pres),
         str_detect(pres, "Rep|Dem"),
         str_detect(us_rep_14d, "Rep|Dem"),
         str_detect(state_sen_32d, "Rep|Dem"),
         !(is.na(state_rep_64d) & is.na(state_rep_99d))
    ) |> 
  
  # Changing ballot choices from candidates' names to their respective parties
  mutate(
    pres = if_else(
      str_detect(pres, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    us_rep_14d = if_else(
      str_detect(us_rep_14d, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    state_sen_32d = if_else(
      str_detect(state_sen_32d, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    state_rep_64d = if_else(
      str_detect(state_rep_64d, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    state_rep_99d = if_else(
      str_detect(state_rep_99d, "Rep"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    sc_justice_20_1 = if_else(
      str_detect(sc_justice_20_1, "Sharon"), "GOP", "DEM"),
    sc_justice_20_2 = if_else(
      str_detect(sc_justice_20_2, "Judi"), "GOP", "DEM"),
  ) |> 
  
  # Creating variable to label whether or not a voter voted exclusively for one party in the races of interest, besides the Supreme Court races
  mutate(
    party_line_voter = case_when(
      pres == "GOP" & us_rep_14d == "GOP" & state_sen_32d == "GOP" &
      (state_rep_64d == "GOP" | state_rep_99d == "GOP")
      ~ "GOP",
      pres == "DEM" & us_rep_14d == "DEM" & state_sen_32d == "DEM" &
      (state_rep_64d == "DEM" | state_rep_99d == "DEM")
      ~ "DEM",
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  ) |> 
  
  # Creating variable to label whether or not a voter's Supreme Court race choices aligned with their choices for the other races of interest
  mutate(
    sc_races_matching = case_when(
      party_line_voter == "GOP" & sc_justice_20_1 == "GOP" &
      sc_justice_20_2 == "GOP" ~ TRUE,
      party_line_voter == "DEM" & sc_justice_20_1 == "DEM" &
      sc_justice_20_2 == "DEM" ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: ashtabula-oh-analysis

ashtabula_oh_2024_table <- ashtabula_oh_2024 |>
  group_by(party_line_voter) |>
  filter(!(is.na(party_line_voter))) |> 
  summarise(
    prop_sc_in_line = sum(sc_races_matching == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) / n(),
    total = n()
  )

ashtabula_oh_2020_table <- ashtabula_oh_2020 |>
  group_by(party_line_voter) |>
  filter(!(is.na(party_line_voter))) |> 
  summarise(
    prop_sc_in_line = sum(sc_races_matching == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE) / n(),
    total = n()
  )


combined_table <- bind_rows(
  "2020" = ashtabula_oh_2020_table,
  "2024" = ashtabula_oh_2024_table,
  .id = "year"
)

combined_table |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Straight-Ticket Voting and SC Races",
    subtitle = "Comparison of 2020 (unlabeled) and 2024 (labeled)"
  ) |>
  fmt_percent(
    columns = prop_sc_in_line,
    decimals = 1
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    year = "Year",
    party_line_voter = "Party-Line",
    prop_sc_in_line = "Voted In Line (%)",
    total = "Number of Voters"
  ) |> 
  gt_theme_538()

```
